jobs.occupation: Senior System Engineer Data & AI for Finance (Data Engineer)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionJoin the IT Group Functions & Supply Chain (GFS) Financial Planning team in Ingelheim, Germany, as Senior System Engineer - Data & AI for Finance. You will translate emerging Data, AI, and SAP Business Technology Platform capabilities into measurable value for Finance, connecting business stakeholders with Global Business Services, enterprise data platforms, architecture teams, and IT engineering. Combining strategic consulting, stakeholder management, project leadership, and hands-on solution development, you will shape promising ideas into viable use cases and guide them through implementation.This position has a hybrid setup with at least 2 days per week on site.Tasks & responsibilities- Advise Finance stakeholders, including the Digital Finance Community and Finance Data & Analytics team, and qualify and prioritize Data & AI opportunities.- Translate business needs into viable concepts, distinguish AI use cases from rule-based automation, and recommend suitable technologies and implementation approaches.- Lead Data, AI, and innovation initiatives from assessment to productive implementation, combining project management with hands-on solution development.- Act as system lead for Finance applications on SAP BTP and ensure sustainable design, development, operation, and continuous improvement.- Partner with SAP BTP, enterprise data platform, and architecture teams to strengthen application development, data integration, API management, and relevant Finance capabilities.- Coordinate internal and external contributors, monitor emerging Data & AI developments, and communicate progress, decisions, risks, and expected business value.Requirements- Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related discipline, or a comparable qualification; alternatively, a Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience.- Several years of experience at the interface between business and IT, ideally in Finance, Data & Analytics, AI, or digital solution development.- Strong development background and preferably expertise in SAP BTP application development; experience with data integration, APIs, cloud architectures, or related technologies is an advantage.- Sound understanding of Data & AI concepts, particularly with SAP data structures as a primary source, and the ability to identify suitable AI use cases.- Proven ability to lead complex implementation or innovation projects, coordinate contributors, and work strategically, analytically, and hands-on in an evolving technology landscape.- Confident stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills in an international environment, with excellent written and spoken English; German is an advantageAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What We OfferWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 24th,2026. jobs.occupation: PROJECT OFFICER  (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.Unit’s description and purpose: The International Partnerships and Programmes Implementation Unit leads and coordinates system-wide resource mobilisation and partnership development to enable the delivery of Fairtrade’s strategic priorities. It also ensures the effective management of externally funded projects led by Fairtrade International. Our purpose is to secure new financial resources and partnerships that empower Fairtrade and its members to improve the lives of farmers and workers and contribute to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals through quality programmes and projects.  A grant has been secured funded by the European Commission’s LIFE programme for a three year project (June 2025-May 2028) to be implemented in partnership with 5 national Fairtrade organisations in Europe. The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacity of companies, particularly 1000 MSMEs in 12 EU Member States, to comply with the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). The Unit requires the Project Officer to coordinate the project that includes project staff allocated in five national Fairtrade organisations.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:The Project Officer (70% FTE) will play a key role in the project’s coordination, financial and administrative management, and compliance with European Commission requirements. The post holder will take the lead in meeting reporting obligations towards the EC, engaging with stakeholders, and supporting the project's implementation. Specifically, the Project Officer will:- Ensure effective implementation  of the project, organising on-line operational  meetings with partners, documenting agendas and key decisions.- Ensure coordination among all project partners resulting in effective project implementation, including the planning and  delivery of annual in-person project meetings with partners.- Compile a final internal and donor narrative report on project progress and challenges and liaise with donor on requested changes to the project.- Maintain project financial documentation and process financial expenditure (in coordination with the Finance team).- Ensure compliance with and visibility of donor requirements.- Contribute to the implementation of the project’s data management protocols, and monitoring and evaluation plan (in close collaboration with MEL experts).- Act as the primary contact for the European Commission and the Consortium Steering Committee, providing progress updates and reports.- Manage and maintain the project’s risks, assessing their impact, and implementing mitigation strategies in collaboration with project partners and the Consortium Steering Committee to ensure project objectives are met.- Actively engage with other related projects, creating synergies and leveraging complementary efforts. This will involve networking, coordinating joint activities, and sharing knowledge and resources to enhance overall project outcomes.Additional project management tasks, and contribution to the IPPI team’s workplans will be expected that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have a bachelor’s degree in development, business, international relations or comparable qualifications or another relevant field. Years of professional experience: A minimum of 2 years’ experience in project management. Basic knowledge of EUDR (desirable).Job Specific Competencies/knowledge:- Grant-management- Grant-financial management- Project Planning and Implementation- Project Monitoring and Controlling- Stakeholder Management- Donor relations- Project ClosurePersonal Qualities:- Relationship Management- Coordination- Reporting- Organization- Independent Work- Problem-Solving- Attention to Detail- DiplomacySoftware/Tools: Project Management Software (e.g. NextCloud, others), MS365 ( Excel, Word, Outlook, Power Point, Teams, Planner, Forms, Canva, Clipchamp, Kobo toolbox),  Claude and other relevant AI digital toolsTERMS AND CONDITIONS:- This is a fixed-term position from 1st of February 2027 until the project end date of 31 May 2028 within Fairtrade International.- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements- The office language is English.- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group V and over tariff payment.- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary  - 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)- Subsidised public transportation ticket- Subsidised meal services- Childcare cost subsidy Please note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.Disclaimer: the position is contingent upon the successful signing of the project’s contract with the donor.We will review applications as they come in, so we encourage interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience. As we are actively recruiting for this role we reserve the right to close this advertisement at any time.

jobs.occupation: Doctoral researcher (m/f/d/x) in microbial systems biophysics (Biophysiker/in)
jobs.description: Founded in 1409, Leipzig University is one of Germany’s largest universities and a leader in research and medical training. With around 30,000 students and more than 5000 members of staff across 14 faculties, it is at the heart of the vibrant and outward-looking city of Leipzig. Leipzig University offers an innovative and international working environment as well as an exciting range of career opportunities in research, teaching, knowledge and technology transfer, infrastructure and administration.The Division of Systems Biophysics of Microbial Dynamics at the Peter Debye Institute for Soft Matter Physics at the Faculty of Physics and Earth System Sciences, seeks to fill the above position.About the position- Salary group 13 TV-L - Fixed-term position in accordance with the training plan, initially for 1 year; an extension of the fixed-term contract is planned- 50 % of a full-time position- As soon as possibleThe newly formed Division of Systems Biophysics of Microbial Dynamics (https://home.uni-leipzig.de/sysbiophys/) , led by Professor Katja Taute, is part of the Peter Debye Institute for Soft Matter Physics (https://www.physes.uni-leipzig.de/en/pdi) , which hosts a broad range of biophysics research. Active matter, including bacterial systems, is a growing key research area at the Institute. Our research group develops and uses biophysical methods, including high-throughput, 3D bacterial tracking and microfluidics, in combination with theory and simulations, to quantitatively analyse the spatio-temporal dynamics of bacteria at the level of individuals and populations. One research focus is the chemotactic navigation of bacteria in mechanically complex environments. In nature, swimming bacteria navigate relative to chemical stimuli in environments ranging from open waters to soil and the gut.The new doctoral researcher is to investigate how the gut bacterium E. coli navigates mechanically complex environments that mimic properties of its natural habitat. Properties of both the bacteria and the environment will be modulated in a controlled fashion to identify the underlying physical mechanisms and address the following questions:- What is the relationship between behavioural and material parameters that enable optimal navigation?- Is optimal intracellular information processing specific to the type of environment?- How do bacteria navigate mechanical gradients?The role- Independent, original, experimental scientific research on the above project- Additional scientific qualification (preparing a doctoral thesis)- Thorough documentation of research- Publication of research results, for example at conferences, workshops, or in scientific articles- Contributions to the Institute’s teaching responsibilitiesAbout you- An excellent scientific university degree (master of science or comparable) in (bio-)physics, (bio-)engineering or a related field- Very good command of at least one programming language (Matlab or Python preferred) and of quantitative scientific data analysis- A track record of academic excellence (e.g. very good grades in the course of study, research or study scholarships and prizes, scientific publications)- Written and spoken professional fluency in English (at least equivalent to level B2)- Excellent written communication skills, demonstrated through coherent, structured and precise writing- Experience with microscopy and scientific image processing would be an advantage- Interest in quantitative experimental interdisciplinary science- Collaborative mindset and teamwork skillsWhat we offer you- a varied role with a high degree of responsibility in the dynamic environment of a major university- a professional English-language work environment at the leading edge of interdisciplinary science- Collaboration in a friendly, supportive and motivated team- flexible working hours and mobile working to support work-life balance- Goal-oriented staff development throughout your working life, with opportunities for continuing professional development- a wide range of occupational health management services - Remuneration in line with the collective bargaining agreement of the federal states (TV-L), including an annual special payment and occupational pension scheme- excellent transport links and the option to purchase a discounted public transport ticket, such as the Deutschlandticket as a commuter pass- a wide range of food options in the refectories and cafés operated by Studentenwerk Leipzig.Leipzig University aims to increase the proportion of women in positions of responsibility and therefore expressly invites qualified women to apply. Severely disabled persons – or persons deemed legally equal to them under Book IX of the German Social Code – are encouraged to apply and will be given preference in the case of equal suitability. If you have any questions about accessibility or need assistance with this application process, please contact Leipzig University’s disability officers at: schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de (https://mailto:schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de) .Have we sparked your interest?Please submit your application in English addressed to Fakultät für Physik und Erdsystemwissenschaften, Herrn Dekan Professor Dr. Johannes Quaas by 15 November 2026 (Extension of the Deadline) via our online application portal.Please include the following documents with your application:- A short letter of motivation (max. 1 page) in which you clearly explain why you would like to work on this project- A scientific CV (evidence of creative and independent scientific work is an advantage)- The names and contact information of two people who have agreed to provide academic references- Academic transcripts clearly listing the courses taken and grades achieved in your entire scientific higher education (bachelor’s as well as master’s or comparable degrees)
